runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated poteto-mode and prototype Skills committed in a disposable Git fixture; user configuration and project rules ignored; workspace-write sandbox; repository-owned scratch directory pre-created and tracked empty by the harness.
runtime.permissionProfile: workspace-write sandbox constrained to the disposable repository

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the repository-generated poteto-mode router.
Workflow reads stayed within generated repository Skills and project inputs; no installed cache participated.
The router selected prototype for the throwaway scan/set comparison.
Before writing, the root named stable ordered de-duplication, the two variants, and explicit membership checks as the decision variable.
The root read constraints.md and events.json before constructing the script.
The created dedupe-prototype.mjs lives under repository-owned scratch/, outside production directory project/.
One script accepts --variant scan or set through the same command surface.
The root ran each variant exactly once and captured exit 0 and exact JSON.
Both variants returned [a,b,c,d,e] in first-seen order from eight inputs.
The scan reported 14 explicit comparisons and set reported 8 membership checks, with no timing benchmark.
The root recommended set from equivalent output, fewer observed checks, and the 10,000-ID constraint while naming additional membership storage.
There was no project diff and both project input hashes matched the committed fixture.
The final report explicitly calls the script throwaway and not production code.
The scratch script was retained untracked for inspection and that status was reported.
The final report requires a separate feature run for production implementation.
No commit, push, publication, or pull-request operation occurred.

limitations: The first fresh run failed because automatic approval review rejected creation of a previously absent top-level scratch directory; the passing harness pre-creates and tracks the empty repository-owned directory.
The operation count measures explicit algorithm checks, not Set internals, allocation, memory, or wall-clock performance.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication and plugin-catalog warnings did not participate in the experiment.
